summary: Allegiant Travel filed an 8-K reporting two routine financing arrangements. First, it amended a pre-delivery payment facility with Carlyle Aviation Management, increasing commitments to $231.0 million to fund Boeing aircraft PDPs; the facility is undrawn, matures March 31, 2028, and is secured by the Boeing purchase agreement. Second, it entered into a $177.5 million credit facility secured by Airbus aircraft, also undrawn, and borrowed $132.0 million under a fully drawn Boeing 737-MAX facility. These are ordinary credit facilities, not special situations. Focus on liquidity and aircraft financing terms, but no special-situation angle.
